instincts.trigger: adding form validation to a Remix 3 controller action (POST/PUT/DELETE)
instincts.action: Use s.parseSafe() instead of s.parse(). Check parsed.success. On failure, extract raw FormData values before validation, convert issues to Record<string, string> keyed by field name, and return context.render() with 400 status and formValues/fieldErrors props.

instincts.trigger: users report that form inputs clear after a validation error
instincts.action: Extract raw form values from FormData before running parseSafe. Pass them as formValues prop to the component. In the component, use the value priority: formValues (submitted) > row (DB) > defaults. Check each input/select: input.value = formValues?.field ?? row.field; select.selected = formValues ? formValues.role === 'option' : row.role === 'option'.

instincts.trigger: writing a controller action that validates and uses FormData
instincts.action: Call extractFormValues(formData) BEFORE parseSafe to capture the raw strings. Even if validation fails, you have the original values to re-render. On the happy path, use parsed.value for the typed, validated output.

instincts.trigger: building a form inside a Remix 3 <Frame> component
instincts.action: Use the URL param roundtrip pattern (Pattern 2). On validation failure, encode form values as fv_ prefixed search params and field errors as fe_ prefixed params. Redirect with these params. On the next GET render, decode them from context.url. Do NOT use direct re-render with 400 inside a Frame context—Frame navigation expects redirects.

instincts.trigger: parsing validation issues from s.parseSafe to display in UI
instincts.action: Iterate over parsed.issues. Read issue.path[0] for the field name (must be typeof 'string'). Map the first error per field using issue.message. Use a helper function issuesToFieldErrors(issues) that returns Record<string, string>. Key constraint: only set if !errors[field] to take the first error per field.

instincts.trigger: rendering error state on an input after validation failure in Remix 3
instincts.action:
Conditionally apply an error style mixin: mix={fieldErrors?.name ? inputErrorStyle : null}. Render the error message text below the input: {fieldErrors?.name ?
{fieldErrors.name}
: null}. Use theme.colors.action.danger.background for error border and text colors.

instincts.trigger: writing tests for form validation in Remix 3 controller
instincts.action: Always use redirect: 'manual' in fetch options to assert the 400 status. Check response.text() for preserved values (value="..." in HTML) and error messages. Test at least: empty submission returns 400, specific constraint violations return 400 with error text, valid submission redirects with 302. Use URLSearchParams body and _csrf token for CSRF-protected routes.

instincts.trigger: using s.defaulted(s.string(), '') with pipe() for form schema
instincts.action: Always wrap pipe() checks AFTER the defaulted coercion. Pattern: s.defaulted(s.string(), '').pipe(minLength(8)). The default prevents undefined values from reaching the check, and pipe chains validation after coercion. For custom logic, use .refine(callback, 'error message') instead of pipe.

instincts.trigger: HTML form uses type="email" with custom email validation schema
instincts.action: Change type="email" to type="text". HTML5 email validation can conflict with remix/data-schema email() check, causing double validation and inconsistent error messages. Rely exclusively on the server-side schema validation. The schema generates the authoritative error message.

instincts.trigger: refactoring try/catch form validation to parseSafe
instincts.action: Replace: try { parsed = s.parse(schema, formData) } catch { return json(error) } with: let rawValues = extractFormValues(formData); let parsed = s.parseSafe(schema, formData); if (!parsed.success) { let fieldErrors = issuesToFieldErrors(parsed.issues); return render(<Page formValues={rawValues} fieldErrors={fieldErrors} />, { status: 400 }) }. This is the canonical upgrade path from legacy Remix 3 form error handling.
